review_comments.body: **Thinking turns back on** With `litellm.modify_params=True`, a Sonnet 5.5 tool-result turn whose assistant history has no `thinking_blocks` loses `thinking={"type":"disabled"}` before this remap runs. Both chat and Converse remove the setting in their earlier history guard. The helper then returns without supplying `between_tools`, so the provider resumes adaptive thinking and the turn can take longer and cost more Exempt disabled requests from those guards and add a regression test that sends a tool-result turn through the request transformation
@greptileai Fixed in 601a4092d0: both guards now skip disabled thinking, with regression tests through the chat and Converse request transformations

Confirmed fixed in `601a4092d09a50202178786e806816ee7cbdeb55`. Both request transformations now preserve the bare `{"type": "disabled"}` value through the missing-thinking-blocks guard, allowing the existing Sonnet 5.5 remap to `{"type": "between_tools"}`. The new chat and Converse regression tests exercise the tool-result turn with `litellm.modify_params=True` and assert the forwarded thinking mode. No further issue here.
